sentences: A strong wall can protect a town from the wind and rain.
I draw a red triangle with three straight sides.
I propose that we all go to the sea this summer.

Our class had some time to do a funny stretch. We reached up high, then held still while our friends began to draw us. Standing like stone figures, we tried not to laugh. Anything could set us off, like a friend making a face! My friends and I pulled the most terrible, silly looks. Even our teacher joined in the fun.

I built a long toy train from my blocks. Each segment was a different colour. It looked so strange and long that my cat did not recognise it! Magnets hold all the segments in place. It uses smart technology to move around on its own. Best of all, I can build it in so many original ways!
I worked very hard on my science project all through the week.
The kind staff at the shop always give very good service.
I read the first section of my new book before bed tonight.

On rest days, my family makes bread at home. We prepare fresh bread and small cakes in the kitchen. My job is to measure the milk, sugar and honey. Mum says a long wait is necessary to get a perfect result. As it rests, the soft bread increases in size. Then the heat turns it a warm brown. We usually share half with the family next door. Making bread is a lovely way to spend the day!

Every morning, my family has breakfast at the same time. We talk about our day, from the fun parts to the serious ones. I tell everyone about my exercise plans for after school. Mum and Dad share what they will be doing too. As a team, we determine who does each job at home. A good talk like this is the best way to continue each day.
We pick a big pumpkin and paint it for Halloween.
Each of my books has a different story to tell.
New technology helps us learn in fun ways at school.

A new student joined our class this week. We gave him a warm welcome, and I was asked to introduce him to the class. I welcomed him and showed him around the school building. We found that we both shared a similar interest in dinosaurs! He is now my best friend, and we spend time together every day.

This year, our school will establish a community garden of its own. Our teacher asked each individual class to contribute an idea. I suggest that we produce corn, flowers, and one giant pumpkin! A garden is good for the environment, and it gives the bees a home. Plants require good soil, sun, and a drink each day. Whether it rains or shines, our purpose is the same. We all want to watch things grow.
I represent my school in the big running race this year.
There is a big difference between my two dogs.
The fresh bread from the market is of very high quality.

A magician came to our school this Christmas! He asked for a helper, and the class picked me. He announced my name, and I approached the stage carefully. He touched my shoulder, and a rainbow hat appeared in his hand! My whole class laughed, especially my best friend. Although I knew it was a trick, it still seemed like real magic. I looked hard, but I could not identify how he did it. Whatever the secret, it was probably the best show ever!

Our class wrote a story book this term. Every child added a character of their own to our written story. My character speaks a funny language of made-up words! A minister who visited our school got the very first copy from our class. Watching people read our book was the best moment. One day, I will study writing at a university.
The teacher will publish our best stories in a little class book.
The kind staff are nice to every customer at the shop.
It is possible that we will see a rainbow after the rain.

This week in class, we learned about division and fractions. Our teacher wrote an equation on the board and showed us how to find the quotient. We had to subtract numbers and find the difference quickly. There are various ways to reach the answer, and each one is fun. I realise now that it is possible to enjoy each sum without any pressure. It is my favourite class, no doubt!

We learned how a strong structure is planned. Every material must pass a hard test. Every surface must indicate no evidence of trouble. A road over water must protect several thousand people who cross it. Its function is to provide a safe and sure path. The condition is checked in the proper way, like previous times. I want to build such structures one day!
We went to visit my uncle at his farm yesterday.
I introduce my new friend to my family.
The farmers provide fresh food for the busy local market.

My uncle works as a doctor at the hospital in our community. Last week, our class went there to say thank you. He showed us the tools and told us about his day. A doctor often has to make difficult decisions in demanding situations, to help someone who is sick. The kind people who work at the hospital have a real influence on me. I look up to them, and I want to help others one day.

Every child at school was looking forward to the big race. I practise running in the park every afternoon because winning is important to me. My whole family came to support me, and I took my usual position at the starting line. Suddenly the race began! I ran as fast as I could and everyone cheered. Crossing the line first was a great success. "You should be proud of yourself," said my teacher.
I found the solution to the problem and felt very happy.
Each individual student worked hard and the whole class did well.
We watch a fun show on the television after dinner.

Our class visited a television station in the city. The station president, an official of the company, met us at the door, and his secretary showed us in. We watched the children's programme being made live! The service depends on the whole team working to a high standard. A woman was talking on the telephone about the stories of the day. The head of the station shook our hands. I thought about that special day all the way home.

In class, we each chose a science subject to study for a big project. My specific question was about how plants grow. To find the answer, I did research and collected data every day. Little by little, I began to understand the problem and worked towards a solution. I used the computer to organise my notes into a separate section for each week. Then I wrote up my complete report. This whole process taught me so much about science. I received an excellent mark, and I felt so proud!
The school committee plans the big summer party for the children.
I read a wonderful book about dinosaurs last night.
Our whole community works together to keep the park clean.

It is a family tradition to celebrate every birthday together. This year, everybody planned a special surprise for my grandma. My mum made a delicious chocolate cake, and I wrote a lovely birthday letter. When grandma arrived, we all shouted with joy! She said it was the most wonderful occasion she could remember. I will always keep that happy day in my heart.

Yesterday we drove a long distance to visit my grandpa's village. The weather was warm and the mountain behind his house looked beautiful. We walked through the forest and saw a little squirrel gathering food. There were flowers everywhere! I wrote a paragraph about everything I saw so I can describe the experience to my class tomorrow.
